description: This file defines an interface 'Zend_Validate_Interface' within the Zend Framework. It specifies the contract for validation classes, including methods for validating a value and retrieving validation failure messages.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Interface
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for validation classes, including isValid() for validation logic and getMessages() for retrieving error messages.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether a given value meets validation requirements; returns true or false.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Returns an array of messages explaining why validation failed.
